recipe.criteria: Static active overhead hang with shoulder girdle depressed by 12-degree clavicle rotations, arms at 179 degrees and fixed grip. Body rises relative to passive reference without elbow flexion. Eight-second maintained hold; entry and exit omitted.
limitations: Procedural demonstration; support samples are not full collision or biomechanical certification.
Timing is illustrative. Holds show the maintained position only; entry and exit are not animated.
